subject: Post-demo: supplier intake & procurement next steps (Acme Health)
messages:

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: supplier intake & procurement next steps (Acme Health)

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get Redwood set up as an approved vendor so you can progress to a pilot: 

What we covered:
- Demo of Redwood Hosted + Dedicated options and brief on Private deployment needs
- Typical procurement path: PO (preferred by enterprise) vs corporate card vs cloud marketplace
- Required paperwork: vendor intake packet, W-9 (US), banking wiring details, and vendor portal enrollment

Requested next steps from Acme: 
1) Confirm preferred commercial path (PO / card / marketplace).
2) Fill the attached supplier intake form and return to procurement (attachment).
3) If PO path: confirm billing contact and typical PO terms (net30 / net45).

I attached the supplier intake form we typically send to procurement — feel free to fill and return. Laura is copied and will handle vendor enablement from our side.

If helpful, we can schedule a 20-min procurement walk-through with your finance team to go over the portal and paperwork.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the summary. We reviewed the packet internally and have a couple of quick questions before routing to finance: 

1) On the intake form there is a field for tax classification — we’re a 501(c)(3) health system. Do you accept W-9 or will you need W-8?
2) Our procurement team wants to confirm whether Redwood supports invoice-level billing (PO) or if you require monthly subscription invoices only.
3) Is there a self-service vendor portal where we can upload our documents?

I attached our internal vendor request (procurement_ref_2317.pdf) for your records. Can Laura advise on the W-9/W-8 question and portal enrollment?

Thanks,
Sara

Subject: Redwood vendor enrollment & forms (info)

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the quick review. A few clarifications from vendor enablement: 

- Tax forms: For US 501(c)(3) organizations we can accept a completed W-9 where applicable; if Acme is claiming foreign tax status we'd request a W-8 but it sounds like W-9 is correct here. If you prefer, we can share a pre-filled W-9 template for your convenience (see attachment: Redwood_W9_Request.pdf).

- Billing model: Redwood supports both invoice-level billing (we'll accept POs and issue invoices per PO) and subscription billing. For PO customers we normally process invoices on net30 unless you have a different standard.

- Vendor portal: Yes — we have a secure vendor portal for document upload and banking details (link below). Laura or Ben can create an enrollment token for your procurement team and push a DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Action items from Redwood:
- I will generate the enrollment token and send an invite to procurement@acmehealth.com (Ben handling onboarding flow).
- Alex will follow up on commercial path confirmation and PO terms.

Laura Bennett
Vendor Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
